subject: Important Update Regarding Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We would like to inform you that there has been a change in the departure time of your upcoming flight. Your flight to Paris on June 15th will now be departing at 11:30 AM instead of the previously scheduled time. Please make sure to arrive at the airport accordingly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team at [Phone Number]. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Sincerely, The Flight Team
